attempts.text:
The only designated evacuation point is Myagang shelter. Benighat temple has not been designated, so nobody can be dropped off there. The Myagang–Jwalamukhi road is blocked, but no one needs to go that way.

| Group | Action | Driving cost | Penalty avoided | Net saving |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 injured at Nilkantha market | Round trip from Myagang | 36 | 320 | 284 |
| 4 adults at Bidur village | Round trip from Myagang | 54 | 80 | 26 |
| 2 adults at Nilkantha market | Second round trip from Myagang | 36 | 40 | 4 |
| 1 adult at Syaphru school | Defer | 0 (a round trip would be 36) | 0 (a rescue would avoid 20) | Deferring is 16 cheaper |

**Other routes:** The loop Myagang–Bidur–Nilkantha–Myagang takes 64 minutes and carries only 4 of the 6 adults at Bidur and Nilkantha. The 2 left behind add a 40 penalty, for a cost of 104. Separate trips to both places cost 90 and rescue all 6.

**Injured first:** The injured are collected on the first trip so they reach safety soonest. This doesn't change the cost.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter nilkantha-market
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 nilkantha-market myagang-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 myagang-shelter nilkantha-market
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 nilkantha-market myagang-shelter
unload car1 adult 2
drive car1 myagang-shelter bidur-village
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 bidur-village myagang-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer syaphru-school adult 1
</plan>

Total cost is 126 minutes of driving (36 + 36 + 54) plus a 20 penalty for the deferred adult.

COST: 146
